paragraphs.text: God may far better say than our Henry VIII, Cui adhaereo, praeest, He whose part I take is sure to prevail. But Christ hath ever been the Church’s champion, and hence she is insuperable. The Chaptain of the Lord’s hosts is Captain of our salvation, Jos 5:14 Heb 2:10.
paragraphs.anchor: If it had not been the Lord, &c.

paragraphs.text: Monsters rather; but such as think themselves the only men alive, and us the only slaves and zanies.

As the great fish do the little ones, as hungry lions, or wolves, ravin up their prey. Ptolemy Lathurus, king of Egypt, slew thirty thousand Jews, and compelled the living to feed upon the dead. Adrian the emperor made a decree, that he who had not slain a Jew should himself be slain (Gualth Praef. in Marc. R. Obad. Gaon in Psa 124:1-8).
paragraphs.anchor: Then had they swallowed us up quick

paragraphs.text: Heb. in the flagrancies or inflammations of their anger.
paragraphs.anchor: When their wrath was kindled against us

paragraphs.text: As once the Red Sea did the Egyptians, or as the general deluge did the old world.
paragraphs.anchor: Then the waters had overwhelmed us

paragraphs.text: Neither could we have withstood it by any art or industry.
paragraphs.anchor: The stream had gone over our soul

paragraphs.text: The same again, to note the greatness both of the danger and of the deliverance. And it may teach us not lightly to pass over God’s great blessings, but to make the most of them.
Deo gratias, thanks be to God was much in Austin’s mouth, and should be so in ours, but especially upon some signal deliverance. How was God blessed at Berachah? 2Ch 20:26
Who meant to have made but a breakfast of us, and had already devoured us in their hopes, but God defeated them.
paragraphs.anchor: As a prey to their teeth

paragraphs.text: Man’s extremity is God’s opportunity. See Gen 22:14 Eze 37:11 2Ki 19:3-4.
God hath with as much ease delivered us as a bird net is broken.
Experience should breed confidence, Rom 5:4-5 2Co 1:10 Psa 48:14 Gen 22:10-11, &c.; write up experiences therefore, oft rub them over, and then conclude as here, and as Php 1:6 2Ti 4:17-18.
paragraphs.anchor: Our help is in the name of the Lord, &c.

paragraphs.text: God’s power is the prop of our faith, and pricks on to prayer; commit we ourselves to him as to a faithful Creator, 1Pe 4:19, of infinite might and mercy; and say, as those good souls, as Aben Ezra, Hitherto God hath helped us; he hath, and therefore he will, &c.
